business_problem: With technology and customer needs rapidly evolving, ZEISS Group felt it needed a modern analytics solution to support its efforts to continuously scale innovation for its advanced products and digital offerings. The company wanted to streamline its analytics workflows to provide internal business units with frictionless access to information that would support more intelligent, customer-centric decisions. To accomplish this, ZEISS Group needed to share information across teams while maintaining a more secure, role-based environment.
solution_summary: With technology and customer needs rapidly evolving, ZEISS Group felt it needed a modern analytics solution to support its efforts to continuously scale innovation for its advanced products and digital offerings. The company wanted to streamline its analytics workflows to provide internal business units with frictionless access to information that would support more intelligent, customer-centric decisions. ZEISS Group knew it could put its “mountains” of disparate data to better use. But the company needed a way to break free of its ever-increasing number of data silos so it could work from a single source of truth across all its data analytics workflows. With targeted technical goals including evolving its enterprise (Big) DATA Analytics platform (eVA, based on the Data Mesh principles) establishing end-to-end data lifecycle acceleration, and supporting business growth through AI innovation, ZEISS Group chose Microsoft Fabric on the Azure platform as its solution.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Provides data warehousing and large-scale analytical processing for unified reporting.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Factory
solution_components.role: Moves and orchestrates data from source systems into the cloud analytics environment.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Hosts the unified lake, warehouse, and analytics environment used to consolidate and model enterprise data.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

data_flow: Data moves from Azure Data Factory and connected sources into Microsoft Fabric, where it is transformed, modeled, and stored for governed access before being served to business users through Power BI dashboards.
